entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

What's the issue? The issue is they're garbage! I went on one ride and they gave me horrible blisters on both heels. I've never had this happen with any other brand. I want a refund, and I want it now.

I understand, that sounds incredibly uncomfortable and I apologize for that experience. Blisters are definitely not what we want for our customers. Just to be thorough, did you have a chance to adjust the cleats or the insole at all?

Are you kidding me? I'm not an idiot, I know how to set up cleats. This isn't a setup problem, it's a product problem! Stop wasting my time with these questions. Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to your manager and write a review about this disaster on every cycling forum on the internet?
There's no need for that, sir. I understand your frustration completely. Let me just pull up your order information and review the return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, I have your order here. I see the cycling shoes were delivered 16 days ago. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you right away.
Okay. Good. That's what I wanted to hear. So how does it work?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Fine. Make sure it gets done.
I will personally ensure it's tracked on our end. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and again, my apologies for the trouble with the shoes. Have a good day.
